### From `packages/core/src/fn-facts.ts`

#### <a id="core-costestimate"></a>`CostEstimate`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/fn-facts.ts`

What a call is expected to cost, in dollars. `basis` says where the numbers come from: `free` (nothing it does
spends), `history` (its settled runs), `payload` (worked out from the call's args and the model's price), or
`unknown` (it spends and has never run).

```ts
type CostEstimate = {
  min: number;
  typical: number;
  max: number;
  basis: "unknown" | "history" | "payload" | "free";
  runs: number;
};
```

#### <a id="core-fnexamplespage"></a>`FnExamplesPage`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/fn-facts.ts`

A page of a fn's examples: `total` of them, `next` the offset of the next page (absent on the last).

```ts
type FnExamplesPage = {
  fn: `${string}/${string}`;
  items: {
    args: z.core.util.JSONType;
    id: string;
    result?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
    note?: string | undefined;
    score?: number | undefined;
  }[];
  total: number;
  next?: number | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-fnexamplespatch"></a>`FnExamplesPatch`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/fn-facts.ts`

A system adds, replaces (by `key`) or removes examples of one of its own fns while running (`examples` on
the hub link). Examples in the fn's declaration are left alone.

```ts
type FnExamplesPatch = {
  fn: string;
  upsert: {
    args: z.core.util.JSONType;
    key: string;
    result?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
    note?: string | undefined;
  }[];
  remove: string[];
};
```

#### <a id="core-fnsearchquery"></a>`FnSearchQuery`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/fn-facts.ts`

A search over fns and context, done in the hub's database. Without `text` it lists what the filters let through,
by name. Every filter narrows: `kinds` (the fn kinds, such as `input/form` or `database/query`), `systems`,
`instance` (a fleet instance's own fns), `visibility` (what the asker shares: `mine` they own, `shared` others gave
them), `types` (fns that read or write any of these named types), `modes` (fns of these modes), and `names` (exactly
these fns and context items, to look up their hits by name).

```ts
type FnSearchQuery = {
  text?: string | undefined;
  match?: "text" | "semantic" | "hybrid" | undefined;
  items?: ("fn" | "context")[] | undefined;
  kinds?: (`${string}/${string}` | "native")[] | undefined;
  systems?: SystemName[] | undefined;
  instance?: InstanceName | undefined;
  visibility?: "shared" | "public" | "mine" | undefined;
  types?: {
    reads?: `${string}/${string}`[] | undefined;
    writes?: `${string}/${string}`[] | undefined;
  } | undefined;
  modes?: ("write" | "read" | "delete")[] | undefined;
  effects?: {
    thing: "types" | "records" | "fns" | "context" | "kinds" | "resources" | "components" | "examples" | "approvals" | "secrets" | "connections";
    action?: "create" | "update" | "remove" | undefined;
    kind?: string | undefined;
  }[] | undefined;
  names?: `${string}/${string}`[] | undefined;
  available?: boolean | undefined;
  order?: "name" | "score" | undefined;
  offset?: number | undefined;
  limit?: number | undefined;
};
```
